segmentationFieldValues[].description: Array of profile field values used to populate dynamic placeholders in the transactional email template. Each item should include `segmentationFieldId` and `value`.

segmentationFieldValues[].segmentationFi.description: Numeric API ID of the Listrak profile field used as a template placeholder.

segmentationFieldValues[].value.description: Value to populate for this profile field in the transactional email template.
